acceptanceCriteria: The probe runs outside the writer lock and its result is revalidated under it.
A test with a slow identity command shows concurrent writers are not blocked beyond the append.
body: Codex finding 2 on PR #1061 (V1-1585 pool batch), left open: the identity probe runs in the lease observer, which the checkpoint route calls while holding the writer lock. A slow identity command blocks every queue writer for up to its timeoutSeconds (cf. #1072 LOCK_TIMEOUT symptom). Expected: probe outside the lock, revalidate under it.
title: pool identity probe runs under the writer lock, so a slow identity command blocks queue writers up to its timeoutSeconds
